name: Quant Alpha
description: A self-improving quant researcher agent that autonomously finds new alphas and retires decayed ones over time.
Evaluation logic is deterministic in quantitative trading, which makes it easy to see whether the agent is actually improving over time.
Self-evolving systems are interesting to me because almost no human intervention is needed for the system to learn, execute, and reflect.
Built at the AI Engineer World's Fair Hackathon hosted by Cerebral Valley.

name: PTI2Go
description: A pre-trip inspection companion for truckers. No more fumbling with paperwork and cumbersome PTI checklist forms — one checklist at a time.
Built, shipped, and live on the App Store and Play Store in less than a week.

name: Whois domain name finder
description: A tool for finding premium domains. It watches domain status continuously and pings you on Telegram (and elsewhere) the moment one frees up.
It can also hunt by length — 2- and 3-letter domains are the premium ones, so it keeps searching for those and tells you when one becomes available.

name: Don't waste
description: A B2C app that cuts food waste at local businesses — restaurants, cafés, and bakeries. Nearby surplus food shows up on a map, either discounted or free.

images.alt: Don't waste app showing nearby surplus food on a map of Tashkent

name: Online quiz system
description: Anyone could build their own quiz and share it — especially handy for teachers assessing their students.
I wrote it in PHP at 14–15, after learning the language in a week. The code is not great and I know there are bugs and vulnerabilities in there. I'm not going to fix them; I'm busy now :((
Still, it was my first "big" project, and it took 1st place at a contest called O'quvchi yoshlar media festivali.
